Command: `dpipe-review.exe transform --input review-input.csv --recipe review-expr.json --output review-expr-out.csv --seed 7`, with values `-4,3,20`. Program wrote empty `score`, `in_range`, `bad`, and `cmp` cells instead of `2`, `1.73`, conditional results, and `NaN`.

Command: `dpipe-review.exe transform --input review-transform-input.csv --recipe review-transform.json --output review-transform-out.csv --seed 1`. Program output header `id,value,label`, retained `id`, did not rename `label`, and sorted ascending rather than descending.

Command: `dpipe-review.exe ingest --input review-unique-input.csv --schema review-unique-schema.json --output review-unique-out.csv`, with rows `1,-1` and `1,5`. Program rejected both rows, marking the valid second row as `duplicate value for unique column: id`; the second row should have been accepted.
